title: Post-100 depth batch 02
notes: Bounded depth batch under Issue #216. Adds four rebrand-continuity events and one current Ctrl shutdown event, with no generic launch/count-padding history. Ctrl existing-record status correction is reviewed separately and will only be applied in the explicit canonical PR if this lifecycle boundary passes candidate/manual review.

events.title: Airbitz announced its rebrand to Edge
events.description: Airbitz announced that the wallet company and platform were becoming Edge while carrying the existing client-side security and wallet lineage into the new brand.
events.notes: This is an entity/product-lineage rebrand event, not the public launch date of the later Edge Wallet release.

events.title: XUMM announced its rebrand to Xaman
events.description: The XUMM wallet team announced the Xaman brand and a gradual transition while preserving the existing wallet functionality and operational lineage.
events.notes: The rebrand announcement does not reset the wallet/product launch chronology.

events.title: Crypto.com DeFi Wallet became Crypto.com Onchain
events.description: Crypto.com announced a new Crypto.com Onchain identity for its existing non-custodial DeFi Wallet lineage.
events.notes: This records brand continuity only. It is not treated as a new wallet or selected-product launch.

events.title: Sui Wallet and Stashed unified under the Slush brand
events.description: Mysten Labs announced that Sui Wallet and Stashed were becoming Slush, with existing Sui Wallet users receiving the new name and interface through the standard update path rather than a separate wallet migration.
events.notes: WLR uses `rebranded` rather than `merged` because the selected existing wallet product continues through the standard update path under the Slush identity; Stashed functionality is acknowledged in the description without creating an unsupported second canonical product relationship.

events.title: Ctrl Wallet shut down normal wallet functionality
events.description: Ctrl announced a permanent shutdown: after removal from app and browser-extension stores on July 7, 2026, normal wallet functionality remained available through August 2 and from August 3 only recovery-phrase export remained while wallet features were disabled.
events.notes: The surviving recovery-phrase export path is a recovery mechanism, not normal wallet operation. If promoted, the explicit canonical correction will set the Ctrl entity to dead and the extension product to discontinued/support ended as of 2026-08-03.

evidence.title: Airbitz is now Edge!
evidence.notes: First-party Edge announcement explicitly states that Airbitz is now Edge while carrying forward the company's client-side security platform and wallet lineage.

evidence.title: XUMM evolves into a new era: Welcome Xaman
evidence.notes: First-party Xaman announcement explicitly introduces the XUMM-to-Xaman rebrand and describes a gradual transition without a new wallet lineage.

evidence.title: Introducing Crypto.com Onchain: The New and Improved DeFi Wallet
evidence.notes: First-party Crypto.com announcement says the existing DeFi Wallet received a new identity as Crypto.com Onchain and continues as the non-custodial wallet product.

evidence.title: Sui Wallet and Stashed are Now Slush
evidence.notes: First-party Mysten Labs announcement states Sui Wallet and Stashed are now Slush and says existing Sui Wallet users receive the change through a standard update without a new download or account migration.

evidence.title: Ctrl Wallet Deprecation: What You Need to Know
evidence.notes: First-party Ctrl notice states the wallet is permanently shutting down, was removed from stores on July 7, remains normally functional only through August 2, and from August 3 allows only recovery-phrase export while wallet features are disabled.
